messages:
Ava Chen: Morning team — quick async handoff before I'm offline at 2pm PT. TL;DR: shipped small perf tweak to KV cache, need one CR reviewed, blocker: flaky unit in runner-tests.

Ravi Patel: Nice — saw the perf numbers, +7% p50 on short seqs. Can you drop the PR link? I'll take a look. :thumbsup:

Ava Chen: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4123 — it's mostly a kernel selection change plus a short test. No prod rollout until CR.

Lena Ortiz: Today: finishing SLO doc for Dedicated regions, will post in #product later. Blocker: waiting on cost numbers from finance for multi-region proposal.

Samir Gupta: I'll ping Finance for the numbers. Also quick FYI — e2e runner-tests flaky failure is due to env race on CI node 7. I reproduced locally. Plan: add a small retry in the harness and file an infra ticket.

Ava Chen: Thanks Samir. If you push the retry patch to the test harness I'm happy to merge fast. CI green needed before we can merge the KV cache PR.

Samir Gupta: Pushed a WIP to fix the race: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/256. It's a tiny change:
```bash
./scripts/ci-retry-setup.sh --retries 2
```
I'll watch CI for the next run.

Marta (deploy-bot): Deploy pipline triggered for branch runtime/pr-4123 (staging). Status: queued (node allocation).

Ravi Patel: Quick CR note: I left one comment about a potential NPE when sequence length == 0. Looks edge-casey but worth guarding.

Ava Chen: Good catch. I'll add a guard and a unit that covers empty seq.

Lena Ortiz: Also, heads up — can any eng rep join the customer call at 11:30 PT? We're getting questions about Dedicated autoscaling policy defaults. Should be ~15m.

Samir Gupta: I can join for the technical bits. Add to my calendar.

Ava Chen: I can make myself available for the first 10 min.

Ravi Patel: On my list: code reviews (2), runbook updates for Canary rollback (small doc), and pairing with DevEx on the SDK batching tweak. Nothing blocking.

Lena Ortiz: Great. One ask: if anyone's touching model routing configs today, please ping #eng-runtime before applying live changes — we're about to run a regional simulation.

Ava Chen: Will do. Last thing — if PR 4123 passes CI, can we aim to merge before 5pm PT and queue a short staged rollout? I want to measure tail latency on staging traffic first.

Ravi Patel: Sounds good. I'll prioritize review. :rocket:

Marta (deploy-bot): Scheduled maintenance window reminder: kube nodes will be cordoned at 03:00 UTC tomorrow. If you have long-running tasks, drain or reschedule.

Ava Chen: Copy. I'll wrap up tests before then. Thanks everyone!

(End of thread)
